caption: The drawing depicts a spinning wheel, rendered in a monochromatic brown color palette with fine, delicate shading. The spinning wheel consists of several distinct parts: a large circular wheel with eight spokes, a supporting frame with turned wooden legs and crossbars, and a treadle connected by a thin rod. Positioned above and to the left of the wheel, there is a distaff holding a bundle of light, fibrous material, likely wool or flax, which is rendered in faint grayish tones. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorative elements, focusing attention entirely on the spinning wheel and its components.
title: Candle Holder
